ἔκτοθεν is the same as ἐκτός. About the battle also Deiochus (fg 6 M. II 18) gives an account. But about the killing of Cyzicus and the whole battle there is no agreement. Ephorus (70 fg 61 J.) says that the Doliones, being Pelasgians and hostilely disposed toward the inhabitants of Thessaly and Magnesia because they had been driven out by them, attacked them, writing in the ninth book. Apollonius followed Deiochus (see above). But Callisthenes in the first book of the Periplus (124 fg 6 J.) says that the inhabitants of Cyzicus attacked the Argonauts at night out of enmity.

21 Et. Gen. (AB) πέλεια: κίρκος is a kind of hawk. There are eight kinds of hawks, as Callimachus says in his On Birds. πέλεια is a kind of dove like the wood pigeon.
